# Verify that the IRI registry credentials reach the bootstrap only when an
# InternalReleaseImage manifest is present.
#
# Without one, the global pull secret keeps exactly the credentials of the
# install config. Adding one as a custom manifest makes the next target
# regenerate the manifests, and the credentials then reach the pull secret
# the bootstrap node pulls with, the global pull secret manifest embedded in
# the bootstrap, and the IRI registry auth secret alongside it.

exec openshift-install create manifests --dir $WORK

exists $WORK/manifests/openshift-config-secret-pull-secret.yaml
dockerConfigContains manifests/openshift-config-secret-pull-secret.yaml quay.io
! dockerConfigContains manifests/openshift-config-secret-pull-secret.yaml api-int.ostest.test.metalkube.org:22625

mkdir $WORK/openshift
cp $WORK/internal-release-image.yaml $WORK/openshift/internal-release-image.yaml

exec openshift-install create ignition-configs --dir $WORK

exists $WORK/bootstrap.ign

ignExtractFile bootstrap.ign /root/.docker/config.json config.json
dockerConfigContains config.json quay.io
dockerConfigContains config.json api-int.ostest.test.metalkube.org:22625

ignExtractFile bootstrap.ign /opt/openshift/manifests/openshift-config-secret-pull-secret.yaml pull-secret.yaml
dockerConfigContains pull-secret.yaml quay.io
dockerConfigContains pull-secret.yaml api-int.ostest.test.metalkube.org:22625

ignExtractFile bootstrap.ign /opt/openshift/manifests/internal-release-image-registry-auth-secret.yaml iri-auth.yaml
grep 'htpasswd: b3BlbnNoaWZ0OiQy' $WORK/iri-auth.yaml
grep 'password: [A-Za-z0-9+/]' $WORK/iri-auth.yaml

-- install-config.yaml --
apiVersion: v1
baseDomain: test.metalkube.org
controlPlane:
  name: master
  replicas: 3
compute:
- name: worker
  replicas: 0
metadata:
  name: ostest
networking:
  clusterNetwork:
  - cidr: 10.128.0.0/14
    hostPrefix: 23
  networkType: OVNKubernetes
  machineNetwork:
  - cidr: 192.168.111.0/24
  serviceNetwork:
  - 172.30.0.0/16
platform:
  none: {}
pullSecret: '{"auths": {"quay.io": {"auth": "c3VwZXItc2VjcmV0Cg=="}}}'

-- internal-release-image.yaml --
apiVersion: machineconfiguration.openshift.io/v1alpha1
kind: InternalReleaseImage
metadata:
  name: cluster
